title: Native reviewer private shell state
description: Opt-in real reviewer call in a disposable read-only source workspace. Supply provider credentials and optionally FARMSLOT_REVIEW_PROOF_BINARY and FARMSLOT_REVIEW_PROOF_MODEL. Assert the native Bash result succeeds under the production sandbox and close the owned process.

shell-state.intent: Source inspection completes when runner-private cwd state stays in the task directory.

retained-terminal.intent: The real terminal control helper receives the current runner's private-state declaration even when its frozen support predates that declaration, with the terminal process boundary intercepted.
